# BAGH manual

User manual of the BAGH quantum chemistry program, built with Sphinx on
Read the Docs.

**Do not edit this repository by hand.** It is generated from the BAGH source
repository by `tools/publish_manual.py`; changes made here are overwritten on the
next publish. Report problems with the manual as issues here.

Build locally:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
sphinx-build -W manual _build/html
```
